evidence: Single package (websocket_server) encapsulating core WebSocket logic, with clear separation of concerns (thread.py, websocket_server.py)
Server logic centralized in WebsocketServer class and WebSocketHandler, with clear module boundaries but no inter-service communication
Use of ThreadingMixIn and Thread-based concurrency within one process indicates single deployable unit
Server.py serves as a simple script entry point but imports and uses the core module, not a distributed service
Test suite is co-located with source and directly tests internal modules, not external APIs
risks: Low modularity outside of package boundaries may lead to tight coupling if module responsibilities grow
Thread-based concurrency model could become a scalability bottleneck under high load
Lack of clearly defined ports/adapters suggests limited testability isolation for external dependencies
